name: The Alpha Gender
source:
It's the year 2030, in Los Angeles. For the last couple years something has been happening to women, worldwide. They've gotten stronger... faster... more aggressive... and smarter. These enhancements didn't happen overnight. They've unfolded and developed over this time, and as far as we can tell are still developing. 

Scientists have some theories, and are analyzing and documenting the "Change" as it's being called, but the puzzle pieces still don't fit. Is it epigenetic? Viral? Why have women changed, but no effect seen in men? Men see their careers and financial prospects shrinking, or in jeopardy, and don't know what to do about it. Some take to the streets, to protest... rage. Some drown themselves in a bottle. Some try to plow ahead and ignore it. But like it or not, it's happening: men seem to be becoming second-class citizens, while women are now The Alpha Gender!

[Edited from F95Zone]

The developer [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/okay-okay-im-100894774]has dropped this game[/url] thanks to the lack of support and criticism they have received.
translation:
这是2030年，在洛杉矶。在过去的几年里，世界范围内的女性身上发生了一些事情。他们变得更强……更快……更有攻击性……而且更聪明。这些增强并不是一朝一夕就能实现的。它们在这段时间里已经展开和发展，而且据我们所知仍在发展。

科学家们有一些理论，并且正在分析和记录所谓的“变化”，但拼图仍然不完整。是表观遗传吗？病毒性的？为什么女性发生了变化，而男性却没有变化？男性看到自己的职业生涯和财务前景萎缩或处于危险之中，并且不知道该怎么办。有些人走上街头抗议……愤怒。有些人把自己淹死在瓶子里。有些人试图一往无前，却忽视了它。但不管你喜欢与否，这种情况正在发生：男性似乎正在成为二等公民，而女性现在是阿尔法性别！

[编辑自F95Zone]

由于缺乏支持和批评，开发者 [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/okay-okay-im-100894774] 已经放弃了这款游戏 [/url]。
